g.desc: Vector paths extracted from page 1 of the official Travel South Yorkshire tram guide. Source: https://www.travelsouthyorkshire.com/getmedia/dc46701c-a64d-42c4-a2eb-c7a6cedd0d30/Tram-Guide_all-routes-valid-from-30-November-2025.pdf Cream-on-blue recoloring to match the website JPEG.
